About Us
Infosphere Technologies is a leading IT services company with delivery centres across India.

Role Overview
- Develop and test enterprise applications using Java and SQL
- Participate in code reviews and agile ceremonies
- Learn our internal frameworks during a structured training programme

Eligibility Criteria
Batch: 2024 & 2025 pass-outs only
Degree: B.E/B.Tech in CSE, IT, ECE or EEE
CGPA: 7.0 and above (no active backlogs)
Minimum 60% throughout 10th, 12th and graduation
Strong fundamentals in Java, SQL and data structures

Compensation & Terms
CTC: ₹4.5 LPA
Service agreement of 2 years with a bond amount of ₹2,00,000
Immediate joiners preferred
Job Location: Bengaluru / Chennai
This is a work from office role.
